correctness.rationale: Exact semidirect-product commutator coordinates reduce the entire word map to a homomorphism A^(2N)→A^N. Cayley-graph connected components of steps s,t are cosets of <s,t>; spanning-tree edge differences generate precisely zero-sum vectors on those cosets over any abelian A. Image size m^(N-c) yields uniform fixed-(s,t) fiber m^(N+c). Ordered generating-pair counts give Jordan J2 for cyclic complements. Explicit targets e0-e1 and e0-e_d prove the iff-prime statement. Eleven exact exhaustive small-group configurations and four divisor-law cross-checks all passed. Edge cases n>=2, identity and unreachable targets are distinguished.

value.rationale: Complete prescribed commutator fibers are natural group word measures and substantially refine the known identity-only commuting probability. The result applies with arbitrary finite abelian lamp groups, determines support by subgroup coset sums, and provides a sharp arithmetic characterization: uniform multiplicities on all nonidentity derived elements exactly for prime cyclic complement. Composite examples show genuinely unequal fibers and divisor-collision phenomena, including equal values at different proper divisors for n=10.
